rules.name: recon-risk-03-snapshot-health
rules.sql: SELECT view_type, status, count(*) AS runs, max(requested_at) AS last_requested FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND requested_at >= :since AND status <> 'MANUAL_TEST' GROUP BY view_type, status ORDER BY view_type, status

SELECT business_unit, view_type, status, resolved_settlement_date, requested_by, requested_at, started_at, left(error_message, 300) AS error_message FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND requested_at >= :since AND (status = 'FAILED' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < now() - make_interval(hours => :stuckHours))) ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at, p.published_run_id, r.status AS run_status, r.row_count AS run_row_count, CASE p.view_type WHEN 'SETTLE_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) WHEN 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) WHEN 'TRADERS_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_traders_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) END AS snapshot_rows FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p LEFT JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = p.published_run_id WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.settlement_date >= :since ORDER BY p.published_at DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT business_unit, view_type, resolved_settlement_date, row_count, round(extract(epoch FROM (completed_at - started_at))::numeric, 0) AS seconds FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND requested_at >= :since AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (completed_at - started_at) DESC LIMIT 10

expect.reason: no FAILED run and no run stuck in RUNNING since the release
every published pointer leads to a COMPLETED run
no published pointer shows an empty snapshot
the slowest refresh stays inside the agreed time (default 900 s, edit maxSeconds in the text if needed)
